hero.title: Events & Service Initiatives
hero.description: Bridging medical excellence with community service through meticulously planned outreach and healthcare programs.

upcomingSection.title: Upcoming Drives
upcomingSection.description: Join our next missions to serve the community.

upcomingEvents.title: Hepatitis B and HPV Vaccination Drive
upcomingEvents.description: Our upcoming vaccination drive is dedicated to protecting everyone against Hepatitis B and HPV, ensuring a healthier and more secure community for the future.

pastSection.title: Past Successes
pastSection.description: The milestones that define our journey of service.

pastEvents.title: Pediatric Vaccination Drive
pastEvents.description: Successfully immunized over 1,200 children against preventable diseases in urban slums.

pastEvents.title: Non-Communicable Disease Screening
pastEvents.description: Screened 2,500+ citizens for Diabetes and Hypertension during the OMC Health Fair.

pastEvents.title: Community Health Fair
pastEvents.description: Large-scale screening and awareness camp reaching 3,000+ participants.

pastEvents.title: RRR: Respond, Rescue, Revive
pastEvents.description: Dedicated to saving lives, the RRR program has trained 5,000+ beneficiaries via hands-on demonstrations. Key training sites include Rashtrapati Nilayam, IIT Hyderabad, police departments (special forces), and the High Court.

pastEvents.title: Stree
pastEvents.description: Stree is our comprehensive women's health program. It's designed to empower and educate through talks on menstrual hygiene, awareness about breast and cervical cancer, and teaching how to do breast self-examinations

pastEvents.title: Silver Strides
pastEvents.description: Silver Strides was an awareness program we held in old age homes to share information on health concerns. We focused on key topics like diabetes, hypertension, kidney and liver diseases, arthritis, and the risks of heart attacks and strokes.
